Apple mlx-swift 0.31.2, revision 2512c5bebfd801c817b5d07828cbfdc44c76fab4, MIT. https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift. Adaptations: exclude generated Metal sources from SwiftPM compilation; accept CHORUS_MLX_METALLIB for the version-matched bundled library. The build downloads the official mlx-metal 0.31.2 macOS 15 arm64 wheel, verifies its pinned SHA-256, and extracts the version-matched shader library. No Python is required at runtime. The extracted library is bundled in app resources. Upstream licenses are retained.
